display.purpose: Self-hosted Syne, 650 weight, 21vw desktop signature; responsive sizes in dark-experience.css.

headline.purpose: Self-hosted Syne for research questions, teaching statements and evidence-page headings.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Manrope for beginner definitions, complete scientific caveats and readable evidence.

navigation.purpose: Manrope links and native controls, with visible Full/Reduced motion status.

shadows.name: glass-surface
shadows.purpose: Application glass surface edge highlights and depth.

shadows.name: readout
shadows.purpose: Ordinary-bit comparison readouts; selected readouts use pink lighting.

motion.name: motion-preference
motion.purpose: System initially follows prefers-reduced-motion. The visible toggle stores a full/reduced override; it is not a three-option system chooser. Storage failure falls back to in-memory preference.

motion.name: wheel-interpolation
motion.value: Lenis lerp: 0.085; autoRaf: false; smoothWheel: true; anchors: true; syncTouch: false
motion.purpose: Manual requestAnimationFrame loop interpolates wheel travel. Touch remains native. Reduced effects use native scrolling.

motion.name: foundations-track
motion.value: JS-guided at width >= 900px with full effects; native horizontal panels below 900px; vertical reduced-effects layout; no-JS desktop vertical and narrow native panels
motion.purpose: Vertical desktop scroll advances three introductory concepts. Arrows provide an alternative; inactive guided panels are inert. Reduced effects present a vertical reading sequence.

motion.name: water-field
motion.value: Original analytic WebGL 1 shader on hardware GL; eight ripple slots; Canvas2D ripples and compositor-only ambient ribbons on detected software GL, unsupported GL, failure or context loss
motion.purpose: Decorative blue/pink atmosphere with pointer ripples. WEBGL_debug_renderer_info labels matching SwiftShader, llvmpipe, softpipe or software select the 2D path to address measured software-renderer startup stalls; no user-agent, headless or benchmark detection. Hidden documents skip canvas draws. Reduced effects draw a still field when needed; the RAF state check continues. Internal resolution and quality are capped/adaptive, without a guaranteed frame rate.

motion.name: pointer-glints
motion.purpose: Original glints update only hovered glass. Reduced effects suppress ripples, pointer-driven glints and lens; touch and no-hover devices hide the lens. The native cursor remains available.

motion.name: route-curtain
motion.value: Eligible internal route click: cover, then router.push after 260ms
motion.purpose: Dark glass route transition bypassed for reduced effects, modified clicks, downloads, external links and file destinations.

motion.name: loader-readiness
motion.value: Scene-ready event and document.fonts.ready; 1800ms scene recovery trigger
motion.purpose: Reveal after readiness; the loader line is decorative rather than measured percentage progress.

provenance.glass: Adapted React Bits GlassSurface fallback CSS from GitHub commit cf2801031f07f53d4684e65b961bde7c2e2a6921. Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz; MIT + Commons Clause retained at /licenses/react-bits-glass-surface.txt. Application adds dark fill, prefixed blur, inset highlights and original pointer glints; no SVG backdrop filters.
provenance.water: Original refracting analytic WebGL 1 wave/ripple shader on hardware GL. Renderer-capability software detection, unsupported GL, setup failure and context loss select Canvas2D ripple rings with compositor-only animated ambient ribbons. Decorative, not research data.
provenance.fonts: Self-hosted /fonts/syne.woff2 (400–800) and /fonts/manrope.woff2 (200–800), font-display: swap; local licenses/provenance retained.
provenance.references: Lusion, Unseen and ImmersiveGarden inform ambition/atmosphere. ImmersiveGarden was inaccessible; no exact-fidelity claim.

extensions.validationScope: Chromium browser checks do not establish a physical Mac or Comet check. Comet is Chromium-based; its physical runtime remains unverified. A separate regression check overrides only the renderer capability-probe label to exercise actual GL drawing/context loss on the software host; this is not physical-GPU validation. No universal rendering, motion or frame-rate guarantee.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Blue pill with dark text; pink hover. Preserve keyboard focus and concrete destination labels. Implementation: .pill-action and .button in app/dark-experience.css.

components.name: Glass surface
components.description: Attributed React Bits fallback CSS adaptation: dark translucent fill, 18px backdrop blur, inset edges and original pointer glints. Opaque dark fill when backdrop-filter is unavailable.

components.name: Experience navigation
components.description: Floating dark glass header with Syne wordmark, creator credit, research links, mobile menu and visible motion status. Implementation: components/SiteControls.tsx.

components.name: Foundations
components.description: Bits, qubits and encoded memory introduced with a bit flip, probability analogy and diagram annotation. Each distinguishes teaching interaction from saved experimental data. Implementation: components/experience/Foundations.tsx.

components.name: History replay
components.description: Blue replay action for 24 saved detector bits across four time boundaries. Retain saved seed, noise, shot, predicted outcome, actual outcome and inspector link.

components.name: Measurement noise selection
components.description: Pressed blue pill selects actual saved test-noise counts; retain training-level labels, denominators and comparison caveats.

components.name: Saved shot selector
components.description: Native select over dark glass, choosing saved simulation shots without changing their provenance.

components.name: Confidence cutoff
components.description: Native range selects saved descriptive confidence subsets. Blue confidence and pink observed accuracy retain labels, sample counts and the caveat that this is not a recommended cutoff.

components.name: Water backdrop
components.description: Original decorative refracting wave field and pointer ripples on hardware WebGL 1. Software renderer capability labels (SwiftShader, llvmpipe, softpipe or software), unsupported GL, setup failure or context loss select simpler Canvas2D rings with compositor-only animated ambient ribbons. Policy addresses measured software-renderer startup stalls without user-agent, headless or benchmark detection.

narrative.overview: Synapse is an immersive ink-dark research experience by Assirem Benseddik, with electric blue and hot pink light, Syne display typography, Manrope body copy, original liquid atmosphere and attributed glass styling. Beginner explanations lead into complete saved evidence and methods. This supersedes the earlier paper/green and silver/acid identities.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted Syne display and Manrope body typography.
Near-black navy surfaces with electric blue and hot pink light.
Large demonstrations, asymmetrical compositions and readable evidence pages.
Original water/ripples and pointer glints; attributed React Bits glass CSS adaptation.
Explicit full/reduced overrides, initial system preference, native touch and vertical reduced-effects reading.
Beginner definitions and clear boundaries between metaphor, analogy, diagram annotation and saved research evidence.
rules: Source of truth: app/dark-experience.css, components/experience/WaterBackdrop.tsx, Foundations.tsx, ExperienceMotion.tsx, ResearchJourney.tsx and components/useReducedEffects.ts.
Legacy CSS --paper is a dark surface and --ink is light text; use current values rather than earlier palette semantics.
Component entries describe application implementations; they do not provide invented standalone HTML previews.
dos: Preserve the owner-requested dark, blue and pink direction and local fonts.
Keep scientific definitions, saved provenance, counts, uncertainty and limitations visible.
Retain accessible controls, native navigation and readable fallback layouts.
Preserve third-party glass attribution and original work provenance.
donts: Do not restore the superseded paper/green or silver/acid identities.
Do not imply the decorative water is scientific data, or that an analogy runs the research experiment.
Do not invent affiliations, hardware results, exact reference-site fidelity or universal performance claims.
Do not claim physical Mac/Comet validation from Chromium checks.
